description: CPU-only phase-1 cold-start preparation; no local fine-tuning or model evaluation. Historical filename retained for compatibility.

phase1.sampling: Round-robin shuffled repositories, unique canonical tasks; invalid records replaced within category

leakage.benchmark_scope: All 494 base and 415 style instances; base CSV alone is insufficient
leakage.canonical_task_key_definition: case-insensitive repository + normalized PR number; derived from instance_id to group Scale-SWE and SWE-rebench variants of the same task

student.local_role: Dataset preparation and tokenizer storage only; no model weights required, no local tuning

reasoning.serialization: Use the student chat template; inspect source messages before mapping reasoning and actions.
